sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The net proceeds to us from the sale of the notes offered by this prospectus supplement are expected to be approximately $296.5 million, after deducting
the underwriting discount and other offering expenses. We intend to use the net proceeds of this offering for general corporate purposes.
